Image Splitter

Split any image into an even grid of tiles — pick rows and columns, preview every piece, and download the tiles individually as PNG files.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WebP…).
  2. Choose how many rows and columns to split it into.
  3. Click “Split” to preview every tile in the grid.
  4. Download any tile individually, or all tiles at once.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What format and quality are the tiles?

Each tile is saved as a PNG at the exact pixel size of its slice, so no quality is lost in the split.

Can I use different numbers of rows and columns?

Yes — rows and columns can be set from 1 to 10 independently, so grids like 3×2 or 1×4 work fine.

Is my image uploaded anywhere?

No. The image is loaded, sliced and saved entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
